Wake camps offer multi-day instruction for kids aged 6-16 with certified instructors and include equipment and a ski show.

quotes.text: Executive Watersports has been my daughters’ summer home away from home for four years now! Not only did they learn to slalom ski, wakeboard, and surf, but they had tons of fun and learned boat etiquette and safety. They have made lasting friendships with fellow campers and counselors who they look forward to spending time with on the water every summer. Executive Watersports has given my daughters confidence in their ability to do challenging things. I’m very grateful for the whole staff and we will be back every summer as long as they’ll have us!
Lake Austin’s finest, EW has been a summer highlight for our kids for many years. Experts in shredding at all things lake, dance parties, and extra sunscreen
Our kids love EW and the team out there. They’re out all day having fun on beautiful Lake Austin, what more could you ask for!
